design_concept.direction: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level quality, elegant, faith-centered minimalist direction
core_principles: Motion as storytelling (slow, purposeful reveals, no sudden flashes)
High-craft photography treatments (spotlights, cropped aspect ratios, tight clipping)
Real, authentic human connection over abstract digital art

typography.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
typography.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight leading-[1.2]
typography.caption: text-sm font-medium tracking-widest uppercase

layouts.asymmetry: Use grid columns spanning irregularly (e.g., col-span-5 and col-span-6 with an empty col-span-1 between) to create tension and editorial flow.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-none font-medium tracking-wide hover:bg-accent_dark transition-colors duration-500
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-text_primary px-8 py-4 border border-border hover:border-text_primary transition-colors duration-500
buttons.donate_cta: fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 bg-primary text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-full font-medium shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300

cards.standard: bg-surface p-8 md:p-12 border border-border shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-500
cards.image_treatment: overflow-hidden aspect-[4/5] object-cover filter contrast-[1.05] brightness-[0.95]

forms.input: w-full bg-transparent border-b border-border py-4 text-text_primary placeholder:text-text_secondary/50 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary transition-colors duration-300 rounded-none
forms.label: block text-sm uppercase tracking-widest text-text_secondary mb-2

navigation.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border/50

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line. Use Framer Motion 'initial={{ y: 100, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }} transition={{ duration: 1, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1], staggerChildren: 0.1 }}' wrapping text lines in 'overflow-hidden'.
motion.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion 'whileInView={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }} initial={{ y: 40, opacity: 0 }} viewport={{ once: true, margin: "-100px" }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}'.
motion.parallax_image: Subtle scale-down on scroll using useScroll and useTransform to go from scale 1.1 to 1.0 inside an overflow-hidden wrapper.
motion.marquee: Slow, purposeful editorial marquee. Use react-fast-marquee. Font: Cormorant Garamond italic. Speed: 30.

hero_faith.description: Shallow focus photography of person raising hand in sunlight (Hope/Faith context)

parallax_abstract.description: Stained glass sunlight hitting floor in a church. Perfect for 3D/Parallax section background.

youth_portrait.description: Smiling young man outside - confidence building

media.treatment: Images should never be bare. Use a subtle inner shadow or a thin 1px border. Utilize arched masks (rounded-t-full) for portraits to feel ecclesiastical/editorial.

sections: Kinetic Hero: Split text/image with line-by-line reveal.
Programs Grid: Bento style linking to spiritual, educational, financial growth.
Impact & Trust: Minimalist stat counters and partner quotes.
Parallax Hero: Stained glass light abstract background.
Numbered Manifesto Chapters: Sticky scrolling index (01. Faith, 02. Education) on left, content scrolling right.
Editorial List: Alternating left/right image and text blocks with heavy scroll-driven entrance animations.
Covering: Spiritual growth, confidence, life skills, education, financial mentorship.
Clean Editorial Form: Inputs as underlined fields only.
Tabs/Select for Volunteer vs Mentor vs Partner.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install necessary packages: yarn add framer-motion lucide-react react-fast-marquee.
instructions_to_main_agent.css_setup: Import fonts in index.css. Extend Tailwind config with custom colors (primary, secondary, text_primary, text_secondary, background, surface, border) and fonts (heading: Cormorant Garamond, body: Manrope).
instructions_to_main_agent.structure: Create purely functional Shadcn/HTML hybrids. DO NOT use pre-built Card components if they restrict the editorial whitespace. Build custom div structures.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive elements, buttons, and form fields MUST include data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic centered layouts. Prioritize left-aligned typography with strong grid asymmetry.
DO NOT use generic gradient backgrounds. Stick to the solid colors provided to maintain an elegant, high-end editorial feel.
Ensure all text over images or semi-transparent backgrounds meets APCA/WCAG contrast ratios. No totally transparent dropdowns/headers.
Apply framer-motion staggered reveals to text blocks and lists.
Add 'transition-colors duration-300' or similar to all hover states.
Use 2-3x more spacing (py-24 or py-32) than typical 'app' designs. Let the content breathe like a physical magazine.
Always use the provided image URLs. Do NOT use placeholder text or dummy image services.
